interpretation: Successful probe detection is inside the device connection_mutex critical section. Conservatively bound the held interval from detect_connector_status entry to drm_modeset_drop_locks entry; caller/PID sequence plus LT9611 bridge marker must qualify. Symbols do not expose mutex addresses; no I2C duration measured.
internal_detection_limit: The bridge connector calls the HDMI hotplug helper, which can reread EDID inside the connection_mutex critical section. The driver EDID path performs DDC register transactions and delays. This is a source lead, not a measured decomposition or an authorized hotplug default change.
